subject: Renewal addendum: GPU top-up + tenant quarantine / reserved-pool hard fence
messages:
From: Sara Connors <sara.connors@aurelia.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Becker <tom.becker@aurelia.com>, Gina Ruiz <gina.ruiz@vendor-sec.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal scope: add 8 GPUs, tenant quarantine and throughput guarantees

Hi Karthik,

As we review our upcoming renewal, Aurelia wants to add 8 additional A100-equivalent GPUs to our Dedicated pool and ensure that those additional resources are logically fenced from other tenants. Two asks:

- Confirm that the extra reserved capacity can be pinned to a logically quarantined pool (we need strict tenant separation for PHI workflows).
- Provide a throughput SLA for the expanded pool (we're targeting sustained 180 tokens/sec per concurrent session and 95th pct latency < 300ms at p95 for typical requests).

Our procurement team also requested an addendum to put the capacity and fencing commitment in the renewal docs. Gina from our security vendor looped in to validate the approach. Can you confirm feasibility and an expected timeline for the isolation runbook?

Thanks,
Sara Connors
Head of AI Infrastructure
Aurelia Therapeutics

---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Connors <sara.connors@aurelia.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Oct 2027 13:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal scope: add 8 GPUs, tenant quarantine and throughput guarantees

Sara — thanks for the clear ask. Short answer: yes, we can do both. Long answer with proposed next steps below.

1) Fencing: we will provision a dedicated reserved pool and apply a logical hard-fence policy. The pool will be tagged to Aurelia and routed only from your tenant with KV cache isolation and strict network ACLs (VPC-level controls for Private deployments, or logical tenancy within Hosted/Dedicated).

2) Throughput SLA: we can commit to a throughput guardrail and a p95 latency target in the addendum. Rishi can spell out the exact throughput modeling for 8x A100-equivalent GPUs and the safe concurrency we recommend.

Proposed timeline:
- Week 1: Internal sizing & runbook draft (SE + Infra)
- Week 2: Send addendum with throughput table and redlines to procurement
- Week 3: Sign + schedule a non-peak migration window for pool creation and tenant fencing (2-4 hour change window)

I'll draft the addendum and share by Monday. If procurement needs a template sooner, I'll attach a stub.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

---
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Connors <sara.connors@aurelia.com>, Tom Becker <tom.becker@aurelia.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Oct 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal scope: add 8 GPUs, tenant quarantine and throughput guarantees

Karthik / Marissa,

I ran sizing for 8 A100-equivalent GPUs on the current model profile Aurelia uses (redwood/llamax-70b-finetuned). Key notes:

- Expected sustained throughput (single-model, batched): ~160-200 tokens/sec per concurrent session at batch sizes optimized by the runtime. To reliably hit 180 tokens/sec at p95 we recommend enabling continuous batching and prefilling the KV cache for hot prefixes.
- Isolation approach: logical quarantine implemented as a reserved-pool that disables multi-tenant scheduling and enforces per-tenant KV cache namespace. We will also enable node pinning and soft affinity to keep Aurelia's models on a subset of hosts.
- Fallbacks: when the reserved pool reaches capacity, requests will overflow to a pre-agreed lower-priority pool with a higher latency SLO; the addendum should document overflow policy and affect on SLAs.

Attached: reserved_pool_quarantine_runbook.md (draft) and throughput_sla_table.csv with the modeled concurrency/latency points.

Action items:
- Karthik: include the throughput table and overflow behavior in the addendum.
- Marissa: confirm list price delta for 8 GPUs + fencing premium.
- Neha: advise legal on the wording for the overflow/fallback clause.

Rishi
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments: reserved_pool_quarantine_runbook.md (runbook draft), throughput_sla_table.csv

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Oct 2027 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Internal pricing: Aurelia top-up + fencing premium

Team — quick internal. Pricing for add-on: 8x A100-equivalent reserved GPUs = $48,000/month list. Hard-fence premium (logical quarantine + runbook ops + priority capacity) = $6,500/month. Total list delta = $54,500/month.

We should propose a one-year commit addendum with a 10% net-new-seat discount on the additional capacity given the strategic nature of the account. That brings monthly to $49,050 and annual commit to $588,600.

Neha — can you confirm whether legal will accept an SLA that ties the throughput guarantee to the reserved pool (i.e., SLA applies only when requests are served from the quarantined pool; overflow pool has a separate, lower SLA)? If so, we'll include explicit wording and the overflow clause Rishi suggested.

Marissa
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Connors <sara.connors@aurelia.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 25 Oct 2027 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed renewal addendum and schedule (attached)

Sara — attaching the proposed addendum (redwood_addendum_v3.pdf) which includes:
- Commitment to provision 8 A100-equivalent GPUs as a reserved pool dedicated to Aurelia with logical quarantine (hard-fence)
- Throughput SLA table: commit to 180 tokens/sec sustained at p95 and p95 latency < 300ms when served from the quarantined pool (see throughput_sla_table.csv)
- Overflow policy: documented behavior and degraded SLA when requests spill to the fallback pool
- Migration window: up to 4 hours maintenance window for pool creation; no expected data loss and KV cache warm-up recommended

Please review and let us know redlines. If you sign off on the language, we'll route to legal and get a countersigned addendum ready for signature.

Attachments: redwood_addendum_v3.pdf

Best,
Karthik

---
From: Sara Connors <sara.connors@aurelia.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Becker <tom.becker@aurelia.com>, Gina Ruiz <gina.ruiz@vendor-sec.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposed renewal addendum and schedule (attached)

Karthik — thanks for the quick turnaround. Aurelia reviewed the addendum and the attached SLA table. A couple of small redlines from security (Gina) around audit logging retention (we asked for 12 months of tenant-level audit logs in the runbook) and a request to confirm that the node pinning will persist across routine kernel updates. Otherwise we are comfortable with the throughput numbers and the overflow policy as written.

Can you confirm a target signature date by EOW and propose two potential maintenance windows (one weekly non-peak and one weekend) for the migration? Once signed we will coordinate procurement.

Regards,
Sara

---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Connors <sara.connors@aurelia.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 16:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed renewal addendum and schedule (attached)

Sara — appreciate the review and the security notes. Confirmations:
- Audit logs: we will retain tenant-level audit logs for 12 months and produce monthly export snapshots on request (note added to runbook).
- Node pinning: node pinning will persist across routine OS/kernel updates; we will capture the exception process in the runbook for rare rebalances.

Target sign-by: EOW (2027-11-05). Proposed migration windows:
1) Wednesday 2027-11-10 02:00–06:00 PT (non-peak)
2) Saturday 2027-11-13 23:00–03:00 PT (weekend fallback)

I'll route the updated addendum to legal now (Neha) and push for countersignature. If procurement needs the DocuSign link asap I can create it once legal signs.

Thanks — will keep you posted.

Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

[Attachments referenced above: redwood_addendum_v3.pdf, reserved_pool_quarantine_runbook.md, throughput_sla_table.csv]
